title: Fix typo in tupled closure methods
Fix stress tensor nomenclature throughout the code

body:
How the implicit boundary conditions are implemented right now for momentum make it such that the implicit BC is applied to the predictor velocity as $$u^\star = u^n + \Delta t G_u + \lambda u^\star$$ before the barotropic correction. 
$$u^\star$$ (if not under an `ExplicitFreeSurface`) does not know about the barotropic acceleration at the moment, so the implicit drag is reduced when compared to an explicit drag that accounts for the presence of $$\eta^n$$ in $$u^\star$$.
For this reason, to recover the barotropic acceleration without needing to thread the implicit BCs inside the barotropic solver which is very complicated (for the implicit free surface we would require an LU decomposition for example), we use an explicit step just to compute the implicit BCs and then remove the barotropic signal from $$u^\star$$.

MWE:

```julia
using Oceananigans
using Oceananigans.BoundaryConditions: IMEXFluxBoundaryCondition
using Random, Printf

const Lx = 1e4  # m
const H  = 10   # m
const Nx = 32

function drag_only_growth(Δt, Cᴰ; Nsteps = 300, Δτ = 15)
    grid = RectilinearGrid(size = (Nx, 1), x = (0, Lx), z = (-H, 0),
                           topology = (Periodic, Flat, Bounded))

    drag = FieldBoundaryConditions(bottom = IMEXFluxBoundaryCondition(0, -Cᴰ))

    model = HydrostaticFreeSurfaceModel(grid;
                free_surface = SplitExplicitFreeSurface(grid; substeps = max(10, round(Int, 2Δt / Δτ))),
                momentum_advection = nothing,
                tracer_advection = nothing,
                tracers = (),
                buoyancy = nothing,
                coriolis = nothing,
                closure = nothing,
                boundary_conditions = (u = drag,))

    # A broadband free surface, so every barotropic mode is excited
    ηᵢ = 1e-3 .* randn(MersenneTwister(1), Nx)
    set!(model, η = (x, z) -> ηᵢ[clamp(floor(Int, x / Lx * Nx) + 1, 1, Nx)])

    η₀ = maximum(abs, interior(model.free_surface.displacement))
    peak = η₀

    for _ in 1:Nsteps
        time_step!(model, Δt)
        η = maximum(abs, interior(model.free_surface.displacement))
        isfinite(η) || return Inf
        peak = max(peak, η)
    end

    return peak / η₀
end

println("growth = peak|η| / initial|η|,  over 300 steps.  1.0 means pure decay.\n")
@printf("%8s %13s %13s %13s\n", "Δt (s)", "Cᴰ = 0.2", "Cᴰ = 2", "Cᴰ = 20")
for Δt in (48, 56, 63, 70, 80, 95)
    @printf("%8d %13.4g %13.4g %13.4g\n", Δt, drag_only_growth(Δt, 0.2), drag_only_growth(Δt, 2.0), drag_only_growth(Δt, 20.0))
end
```

On `main`:

```
  Δt (s)      Cᴰ = 0.2        Cᴰ = 2       Cᴰ = 20
      48             1     3.156e+13     3.622e+17
      56             1     1.056e+13     1.062e+16
      63             1     4.887e+11     3.271e+15
      70             1     1.462e+12     1.444e+14
      80          4.56     1.607e+14     8.908e+15
      95         3.832     1.375e+12     3.848e+13
```
